Two mint lanes, both a random draw from the same pool: - Free Mint: mint() is FREE (0 BNB) for the first 500 mints, then   0.0001 BNB per mint once the 500 free mints are used. - Paid Mint: mintPaid() is 0.002 BNB per mint, available from the   moment mint opens (not phase-gated). It never consumes the free   mint allocation. Mint fees stay in the contract (\"fee goes to the contract wallet\") and only the owner can withdraw them with withdraw(). Minting requires a Binance Agent ID: the minter must hold at least one Agent ID (ERC-721) from the registry registered at deploy time. Brewing and the potion shop have no Agent ID gate. No whitelist. Mint starts CLOSED. Nobody can mint until the owner opens it with setMintOpen(true). The owner can close it again at any time. Potion Lab brewing: anyone can pay the brew fee with brew() to play one round of the Potion Lab game. Brew fees stay in the contract together with the mint fees and are withdrawn by the owner with withdraw(). Brewing starts OPEN; the owner can close it with setBrewOpen(false). Potion shop: anyone can buy a potion from the 56-combination catalog with buyPotion(potionId) for 0.0005 BNB. The purchase is recorded on-chain in purchases(); the potion catalog itself lives off-chain. Shop fees stay in the contract and are withdrawn by the owner with withdraw(). The shop starts OPEN; the owner can close it with setShopOpen(false). Artwork is generated fully on-chain from the token ID (deterministic SVG data URI): same token ID always renders the same wizard ape. approve(address,uint256).details: Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account. The approval is cleared when the token is transferred. Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Returns the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for `tokenId` token.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

agentIdRegistry().notice: Binance Agent ID registry, registered once at deploy time via the constructor argument. Minting requires balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0 on this registry. Brewing and the potion shop do not check it.

brew().notice: Pay the brew fee for one round of the Potion Lab game. The fee stays in the contract together with the mint fees and is withdrawn by the owner with withdraw(). The brew result itself is computed off-chain from the chosen ingredients; this call records the paid brew on-chain and counts it in brewCount.

brewOpen().notice: Brewing starts OPEN. The owner can close it with setBrewOpen(false) and reopen it at any time.

buyPotion(uint256).notice: Buy one potion from the shop catalog for SHOP_PRICE. potionId is an index into the 56-combination catalog (0-55) that lives off-chain; this call only records the purchase on-chain in purchases(). The fee stays in the contract together with the mint and brew fees and is withdrawn by the owner with withdraw().

currentPrice().notice: Price of the next mint() call: 0 while free mints remain, MINT_PRICE once the FREE_MINT_LIMIT free mints are used.

freeMinted().notice: How many of the FREE_MINT_LIMIT free mints have been used. Only mint() during the free phase increments this; mintPaid() never touches it.

freeRemaining().notice: How many free mints are left (0 once the allocation is used).

mint().notice: Mint a random unminted token ID. The ID is drawn by the contract from the unminted pool (swap-and-pop) — it cannot be chosen by the minter. Every ID 1-1111 is drawn exactly once. Free Mint: the first FREE_MINT_LIMIT mints are free (0 BNB); after that, mint() costs MINT_PRICE. Any excess payment is refunded (for a free mint, the full msg.value is refunded). The caller must hold at least one Binance Agent ID from the registry registered at deploy time.

mintOpen().notice: Mint starts CLOSED. Nobody can mint until the owner opens it with setMintOpen(true). The owner can close it again at any time.

mintPaid().notice: Paid Mint: mint a random unminted token ID for PAID_MINT_PRICE, available from the moment mint opens. Same random draw, same Agent ID and mint-open gates as mint(), same refund behavior. Does not consume the free mint allocation.

purchases(address,uint256).notice: On-chain record of potion shop purchases: purchases[buyer][potionId] is true once that buyer has bought that potion (potion IDs 0-55, the 56 combinations of 8 ingredients taken 3 at a time).

remaining().notice: How many token IDs are still unminted. Valid pool indices are 0 .. remaining-1; it starts at MAX_SUPPLY and drops by one per mint.

setBrewOpen(bool).notice: Open or close brewing. Owner only. Brewing is open at deploy.

setMintOpen(bool).notice: Open or close minting. Owner only. Mint is closed at deploy.

setShopOpen(bool).notice: Open or close the potion shop. Owner only. The shop is open at deploy.

shopOpen().notice: The potion shop starts OPEN. The owner can close it with setShopOpen(false) and reopen it at any time.

withdraw().notice: Withdraw collected mint, brew, and shop fees to the owner.
